g.text: Native outputs. Grids: run median and observed run min–max. Random graphs: bar = median of three graphwise run medians; markers show every graph seed and whiskers span

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #454545

g.text: those three medians. Each stochastic method has 10 runs per graph. Random graphs are not conditioned on connectivity; zero ranks are retained.
